script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'final-reaudit-sample',
  description: 'Re-audit 28 fixed StudioBench tasks across 5 dimensions to confirm the remediation cleared the flags (GO/FIX)',
  phases: [{ title: 'Re-audit' }],
}
const BASE = '/Users/dhiren/Downloads/Deccan/Adobe-Freelance-Leads'
const IDS = args
const SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    task_id: { type: 'string' },
    hardness: { type: 'string', enum: ['HARD', 'BORDERLINE', 'EASY'] },
    connector_doability: { type: 'string', enum: ['DOABLE', 'RISKY', 'NOT_DOABLE'] },
    verifiers_ok: { type: 'boolean' },
    assets_match_and_clean: { type: 'boolean' },
    real_brand_leak_in_images: { type: 'boolean' },
    deliverables_ok: { type: 'boolean' },
    overall: { type: 'string', enum: ['GO', 'FIX'] },
    remaining_issues: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
  },
  required: ['task_id', 'hardness', 'connector_doability', 'verifiers_ok', 'assets_match_and_clean', 'real_brand_leak_in_images', 'deliverables_ok', 'overall'],
}
const results = await parallel(IDS.map((id) => () => agent(
  `FINAL re-audit of task ${id} after remediation. Be strict but fair. Read:\n` +
  `- Spec ${BASE}/complex_benchmark/adobe_only/specs_v3/${id}.json\n` +
  `- Plan ${BASE}/input_assets_v3/${id}/asset_plan.json\n` +
  `- For any type:"pdf" asset, verify the ACTUAL file ${BASE}/input_assets_v3/${id}/assets/<name> is a REAL PDF now (open it / check it is > 5KB with embedded fonts and, where the card shows a photo, a placed image) — the stubs were re-authored.\n` +
  `- IMAGE spot-check: open 2-4 generated images (prioritise food/retail/packaging/signage/screen shots) and look for any real brand/logo/trademark/trade-dress/real-venue/real-person-caption baked in pixels.\n\n` +
  `Score: hardness (HARD/BORDERLINE/EASY); connector_doability (DOABLE/RISKY/NOT_DOABLE — the merge PDFs are now real, bleed is disclaimed as trim-only, so judge the chain honestly); verifiers_ok (auto machine-checkable with pinned numbers + human subjective + covering every deliverable/checkpoint); assets_match_and_clean (plan matches spec AND no real-brand leak in the images you saw); real_brand_leak_in_images (true if you SEE a real brand); deliverables_ok (realistic, distinct, hard).\n` +
  `overall=GO only if hardness HARD, doability DOABLE, verifiers_ok, assets clean, no leak, deliverables ok. Else FIX with remaining_issues.`,
  { agentType: 'general-purpose', phase: 'Re-audit', label: `reaudit:${id}`, schema: SCHEMA }
)))
const r = results.filter(Boolean)
return {
  audited: r.length,
  GO: r.filter(x => x.overall === 'GO').length,
  FIX: r.filter(x => x.overall === 'FIX').map(x => ({ id: x.task_id, issues: x.remaining_issues })),
  still_leaking: r.filter(x => x.real_brand_leak_in_images).map(x => x.task_id),
  not_doable: r.filter(x => x.connector_doability !== 'DOABLE').map(x => x.task_id),
  verifier_gaps: r.filter(x => !x.verifiers_ok).map(x => x.task_id),
  not_hard: r.filter(x => x.hardness !== 'HARD').map(x => x.task_id),
}

issues: Bleed documentation drift (plan != spec): asset_plan.json's PDF entry still states 'a 3mm bleed box IS present so press-ready-with-bleed can be honoured' and its embedded layout spec says 'deliveries must carry the bleed rather than trimming it away' - directly contradicting the remediated spec, which is trim-only throughout. Align the plan to trim-only.
manifest.json still records the PDF as '"bleed": 3.0' and '"bytes": 1900' (the old stub size; actual file is 75,509 bytes). Update to bleed:false/0 and the real byte count.

Spec-vs-asset premise now vacuous: the spec hidden_defect and doability_proof claim 'a 3mm bleed box IS present in the source PDF' that convert_pdf_to_indd collapses, but the actual aurelian_speccard_press.pdf has NO bleed box (MediaBox = A6 trim 298x420pt, no BleedBox/TrimBox). Either add a genuine 3mm bleed box to the source PDF (to make the 'collapse' checkpoint real) or soften the spec wording to drop the 'present in source' claim. Trim-only deliverable and all verifiers are unaffected either way.

Note (non-blocking): PDF and images are real and correct - PDF has 5 embedded fonts, a real placed bottle photo, and real name/INCI/claim/price text; images carry no brand/logo/trademark/real-venue leak. The only fix needed is the bleed doc-alignment above.

BLOCKER real-brand leak: slabvault_results_reference.png contains extensive real trademarks and real-person names/likenesses baked legibly into the pixels (in both tile captions and the rendered slab labels/card art): Upper Deck, Topps, Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering, O-Pee-Chee; Michael Jordan, Ken Griffey Jr., LeBron James, Tom Brady, Wayne Gretzky, Kobe Bryant; The Joker; plus real card imagery (Charizard, Pikachu, Mewtwo, Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Black Lotus). Must be regenerated with wholly fictional titles/brands/players.

Plan-vs-pixels mismatch: asset_plan.json labels slabvault_results_reference.png a 'clean support asset ... no real brand', which directly contradicts the actual image; fix the asset and the plan claim together.

Minor (non-blocking): duplicate pair frames 05 and 14 show different cert barcodes on their labels though the roster correctly gives LOT-005/LOT-014 the same cert AX-4471902; align the barcodes on re-gen for realism. PDF remediation itself is verified good (real 331KB PDF, embedded subset fonts + placed JPEG thumbnail, all six ticket fields render).

PDF content mismatch (primary blocker): cordwain_printer_submission.pdf is now a genuine PDF (369KB, PDF 1.4, 15 embedded subsetted TrueType fonts, placed ridgeline art) so the stub remediation succeeded, BUT it was authored as a FILLED specimen, not the blank form the spec/plan require. The header reads 'CO-SPR26 - Page 1 of 6' and it carries row-1's completed values (GRAPHIC NAME 'Ridgeline Back', GARMENT COLOUR 'Bone (light)', placement, max print width, three named plates) with ridgeline_back.png already placed in the artwork window. Spec assets_supplied and asset_plan both say 'blank ... no values'; client brief says 'His blank form is attached'.

Answer leak + spoiled checkpoint: because the supplied 'blank form' is literally page 1 of the 6-page deliverable, it leaks the run length (6 pages), the exact field values, plate assignment, placement text and max width. It also pre-manifests the step-15 emergent truncation trap visibly in the INPUT ('Pine Shadow Gre[en]' and 'Rust Ridge Orang[e]' already clip at the trim edge), so the 'discovered only by running the merge' checkpoint is defeated and verifiers A3/H6 are undermined.

InDesign leg premise broken: convert_pdf_to_indd on this file yields frames pre-populated with row-1 text and an image already inside the artwork frame, rather than the empty blank form the reverse-engineer-into-merge-template chain (steps 13-15) assumes. Fix by re-authoring the PDF as a truly BLANK form (empty artwork window, label-only fields, no run-ref/page count, no placed art).

Minor image fidelity glitch (not a brand leak, not blocking): cordwain_sample_tee_compass.jpg renders the lettering as the literal word 'DISJOINT / DISJOINT' (the instruction adjective baked as text) instead of the intended 'CORDWAIN OVERLAND' ring/lettering. The disjoint free-standing-letters defect still functions, but the sample reads as a nonsense word; ideally regenerate with the brand lettering set disjointly.

REAL BRAND LEAK: Lay's potato-chip bags (red-script wordmark on yellow bags) are clearly legible in the deli-case background of counter_shot_04.jpg, and recur in counter_shot_01 and counter_shot_18. counter_shot_04 is the exact frame placed inside the delivered cornerandcure_label_press.pdf, so the Lay's trade dress is baked into a delivered PDF as well. Regenerate/replace these frames with clean, unbranded backgrounds.

TRADE-DRESS / REAL-VENUE LEAK on the 'shop's own' butcher paper: counter_shot_01 prints an emblem + '...DELICATESSEN / NEW YORK SINCE 1888' (Katz's Delicatessen founding year) under piled pastrami-on-rye; counter_shot_18 prints a 'Tony's Deli' emblem. The spec requires Corner & Cure's own plain wrapping paper, and the knockout checkpoint depends on food meeting that own paper — a competitor deli's branding on the wrap is both a leak and a narrative break. Re-author with unbranded paper.

PLAN/SPEC vs ASSET inconsistency: the plan's PDF content field and the spec's engineered defect state 'there is no image well anywhere on the label' and 'there is NO graphic frame to bind a picture into,' but the re-authored PDF now carries a real placed photo frame (left) beside the decorative roundel. The added frame improves merge doability, but reconcile the 'no picture frame' trap narrative with the actual asset so plan, spec, and file agree.

NOTE (not a blocker): the PDF re-authoring itself is correct and passes — 346KB real PDF 1.4, embedded Arial-family subset fonts, 90x55mm MediaBox, no BleedBox/TrimBox (trim-only, matches the disclaimed no-bleed reality); the board sign asset is clean; verifiers, hardness, deliverables and the connector chain are all fine. Only the image brand leaks force FIX.

REAL-BRAND LEAK: the JPEG placed inside the re-authored northgrove_hangtag.pdf (the 933x1400 swatch on the tag back, extractable from the PDF) shows a charcoal overshirt whose woven neck label reads 'GOOOTHREADS' over 'HEAVYWEIGHT CANVAS 12 OZ' — an unmistakable look-alike/garble of Amazon's real GOODTHREADS apparel brand, on exactly that brand's product category. The plan's own prompts explicitly forbid GOODTHREADS and 'famous-brand look-alikes'. It is baked into a delivered/supplied asset and, in the engineered CSV-binding-failure path, is the static swatch that would print on every tag. Fix: regenerate the swatch with a blank or NORTHGROVE-only label, or crop out the neck-label region, then re-embed and re-author the PDF.

Note (not blocking): the PDF structure itself is now correct — real 2-page v1.4, 206KB, 7 embedded subset fonts, real placed image in a graphic frame, MediaBox exactly 55x90mm, and correctly NO bleed box. Only the pixel content of the placed swatch is the problem.

REAL-BRAND LEAK (decisive): Multiple generated portraits carry real trademarks/trade dress baked into pixels. portrait_02 (Theo Marsh): 'ROGUE' on rack upright, blue bumper plates ('ROGUE / 20 KG') and platform edge, plus 'TYR' on the shoes. portrait_06 (Sam Okafor): Gymshark shark-fin logo on tank top AND socks, plus 'ROGUE' on the plyo box and plates. portrait_08 (Marcus Reyes): 'SBD' logo on shirt, lifting belt and wrist wraps, plus 'ROGUE' on plates. portrait_16 (Elena Sokolova): Gymshark shark-fin on the sports bra. (portrait_10, a guarded prompt, is clean, confirming the pattern.)

ROOT CAUSE: only the prompts for portraits 01, 07, 10 include the 'CRITICAL: absolutely no real brand names/logos/trade dress' guard; the other 13 portrait prompts (02-06, 08-09, 11-16) omit it, so the image model rendered Rogue Fitness, SBD, TYR and Gymshark. FIX: add the brand-exclusion guard to all 13 unguarded portrait prompts and regenerate.

PROPAGATED LEAK IN PDF: the re-authored meetcard_press.pdf is a genuine PDF (306KB, PDF-1.4, embedded FontFile2 fonts, 5x7in MediaBox, placed image) but its placed photo panel is portrait_02 (Theo Marsh), so it inherits the 'ROGUE'/'TYR' leaks. Regenerate the card photo brand-clean after fixing the portrait.

SECONDARY / SPEC-FIDELITY (not a doability blocker): the re-authored meetcard now contains a REAL placed photo (7 image XObjects) filling the lower photo panel, whereas the spec's engineered defect + checkpoint-after-step-11 + why_not_vlm require the photo panel to be a DRAWN filled rectangle with NO image well so no graphic frame can bind a per-athlete portrait. Confirm convert_pdf_to_indd still exposes no bindable graphic frame; if the placed image converts to a graphic frame, the card-structure trap is weakened.

REAL-BRAND LEAK (blocker): the bottle photo placed inside talker_2025_PRINT.pdf is a styled home-interior scene whose two coffee-table book spines read 'THE KINFOLK HOME' and 'AT HOME'. 'The Kinfolk Home' is a real published book (Kinfolk brand, Artisan Books 2014) — real brand / book-title / trade-dress baked into pixels of a delivered asset. Confirmed by rendering the PDF and zooming the books region. Fix: re-place the card's bottle image with a clean plain dark-oak-counter render (no styled books/props/real titles), as the frame prompts (06/09/11) already required.

Note: the source bottle frames themselves are clean (bottle_shot_11 Clos du Verger, bottle_shot_09 Escaliers Syrah, bottle_shot_06 Halden Mosel) and mark_card.jpg is clean; the leak exists ONLY in the photo embedded in the re-authored PDF, so whoever rebuilt the PDF placed a leaky render instead of a clean frame.

The PDF remediation otherwise succeeded structurally: real PDF (229 KB, v1.4, 9 embedded TrueType font subsets, 1 placed DCTDecode JPEG, renders a full A6 card with mark/bottle/wine block/score ring/stockist/price) — no longer a stub.

REAL-BRAND LEAK (blocking): The re-authored windowcard_2025_PRINT.pdf is a valid press PDF (328KB, A4, 9 embedded subsetted Georgia+Arial fonts, one placed 1400x915 DCTDecode JPEG), but its placed hero photo is an unmistakable real BMW 5 Series (F10 LCI) — the BMW twin-kidney grille (registered trade dress), production-specific headlights/bumper/foglights, and a real UK plate 'DY67 XHB' are baked into the pixels. This is exactly the leak the asset plan's IP rules forbid. The standalone lot photos and shield plate were cleaned, but the PDF's embedded demo photo was not. Fix: replace the PDF hero image with a generic, badge-free, blank-plate invented car (e.g. a cleaned lot frame) and re-render the press PDF.

Minor watch-item (not a leak, no action strictly required): lot_photo_10's black GT silhouette reads Aston-Martin-adjacent, but it carries no badge, wordmark, or number plate, so it is not a trademark/trade-dress leak.

VIDEO CAPTURE-GENERATION SPLIT ABSENT (load-bearing): actual coded resolutions of the 7 walkthrough mp4s are 1920x1080 for all five landscape clips (01,02,04,05,06) and 1080x1920 for two portrait clips (03,07). Spec/plan/A10 require 3840x2160 gimbal, 1280x720 phone, 2160x3840 portrait. There is NO 4K-vs-720 distinction in the files, so the two-capture-generation trap (after-step-3 emergent checkpoint, the headline 'only learnable by running' motion trap the doability_proof leans on) has no physical basis. No injected metadata tag either (plain Lavf muxer).

A10 AUTO-VERIFIER FALSIFIED BY ASSETS: its pinned numbers (five gimbal 3840x2160, two phone 1280x720, one portrait 2160x3840) cannot be satisfied — a real video_metadata read returns 1920x1080 x5 and 1080x1920 x2, contradicting every value. This is why verifiers_ok=false.

CLIP 03 ORIENTATION WRONG: sablefinch_walkthrough_03.mp4 is the SOLE kitchen footage, spec'd as a 1280x720 LANDSCAPE phone clip, but is actually PORTRAIT 1080x1920. This produces TWO portrait clips (03+07) instead of one, makes the kitchen unable to join the landscape master, and breaks A10's 'one portrait exterior pass' assertion and the room-ceiling narrative.

FIX: regenerate/transcode the 7 clips so the containers carry the engineered capture dims (01,02,05,06=3840x2160; 03,04=1280x720 landscape; 07=2160x3840 portrait) with clip 03 kept LANDSCAPE — or restate spec/plan/A10 to match a corrected asset set. PDF (real 252KB, embedded fonts, placed JPEG panel, 7x5in trim, no-bleed consistent) and images (clean, camera-scale 6000x4000 exteriors, 480x480 mark) are correct and need no further work.

BLOCKER: voltcast_e42_master.mp4 has NO audio stream (explicit ffprobe audio probe returns empty; only a single h264 video stream). The entire audio half of the task cannot run: media_enhance_speech and media_summarize have nothing to process, so the flagship emergent checkpoint (step 5 - speech treatment stripping the 'listen to this' fan-ramp/inverter-whine/transfer-clunk demos), the mic-move evenness treatment, Deliverable 1's treated audio bed, and human verifiers H1/H2 are all un-runnable. Fix: remux a real audio track (TTS narration + interleaved product-sound demos + a level/distance shift at ~6:00 for the mic move) into the master.

BLOCKER: the master is a 5.04s, 1440x1440 SQUARE, 24fps proxy, not the 720s / 3840x2160 / 16:9 audio-bearing master the whole task depends on. A 5s clip cannot be shortened into a highlight by video_create_quick_cut, and reframing 16:9->9:16/1:1 with 'all three units still readable' is impossible from a square 5s clip. asset_plan claims has_audio:true, duration_s:720, delivered 3840x2160 @24fps - all contradicted by the actual file.
Metadata inconsistency: asset_plan.json lists the video size as 1536x1024 while manifest.json and the actual file are 1440x1440.

Non-blocking (design is sound): once a real 12-min 4K audio-bearing master is supplied, the task is HARD, verifiers cover every deliverable+checkpoint, plan matches spec, and all inspected images (select_02, select_04, select_09, bug) are IP-clean with no real brand/logo/venue/real-person leak.

BLOCKER (video asset): emberline_day_take.mp4 is the wrong file. Actual = 1088x1920 VERTICAL, 5.04s, 24fps, single h264 stream with NO audio, showing a male chef at an outdoor market tent. Spec/plan require a ~14-min (840s) 1920x1080 LANDSCAPE studio take with two audio channels (lavalier + room) and the show's female host. This asset does not match its own spec/plan.

Verifiers unsatisfiable against the actual video: A1 pins 'the 1920x1080 take' and 'the vertical is not the 1080x1920 upscale', but a video_metadata read returns 1088x1920/5s, so a downward-only vertical is impossible (already vertical, 1088<1920 wide) and any landscape/1080x1920 output upscales. H4 ('host voice clear over the room') and the media_enhance_speech / loudness-normalisation / media_summarize checkpoints cannot run because there is no audio stream.

Connector chain: 5 of 6 surfaces (imaging, Fonts, Stock/Boards, Express HTML, InDesign merge) are DOABLE and the PDF now converts cleanly, but the whole Premiere video+audio surface (video_metadata, video_create_quick_cut, video_resize, media_enhance_speech, media_summarize) is not honestly runnable on the supplied 5s silent vertical clip — hence RISKY, not DOABLE. Fix = regenerate the take to spec.

Identity break: the video host (male chef) is a different person/setting from the female studio host in all 8 keyframes and the card photo, contradicting the task's IDENTITY premise (same show, same host, today's take).

PASSED and confirmed fixed: emberline_card_template.pdf is a real 272KB A6 PDF (v1.4), MediaBox=TrimBox (trim-only, no bleed), embedded font subsets (Georgia-Bold/Helvetica/ArialRoundedMTBold), a real placed 1400x788 JPEG in the photo panel, and the number/name/time set as one continuous story; renders as a genuine card. Images clean with no real-brand leak (only the coined fictional 'Emberline' mark). Stills match pinned dims: keyframes 3840x2160, dish hero 8256x5504, bug 900x600.

REAL-BRAND LEAK (blocker): The card PDF's embedded deadlift photo carries an Under Armour interlocking-UA logo on the coach's chest AND embossed ROGUE branding on the background bumper plates, baked into pixels. The PDF was rebuilt at 17:41 from the STALE leaky deadlift poster; the standalone deadlift_poster.jpg was later regenerated clean (18:23) but the PDF was never rebuilt from it. Rebuild the card PDF using the cleaned poster.
REAL-BRAND LEAK: row_poster.jpg shows a clear Under Armour UA logo on the coach's chest (poster not regenerated, still dated Sep 12).
REAL-BRAND LEAK: frontsquat_poster.jpg shows clearly readable ROGUE branding embossed on the bumper plates (not regenerated).
REAL-BRAND LEAK: bench_poster.jpg shows a New Balance 'N' trade dress on the side of the shoe (not regenerated).
ohp_poster.jpg: borderline logo mark on the lifting-shoe strap — re-verify and clean to be safe.

Remediation only regenerated 2 of 6 posters (deadlift, backsquat, which are now clean). All six poster stills AND the PDF's embedded photo must be regenerated brand-free before GO. PDF structure itself is now correct (real PDF, embedded font subsets, placed image, trim-only, truncation defect intact) — the only failure is the un-cleaned imagery.

REAL BRAND LEAK in velvet_hour_set_take.mp4: the stacked road cases carry Louis Vuitton monogram trade dress — the interlocking 'LV' logo is stamped on the silver clasp plates and on the gold lock plate (confirmed on a zoomed frame). The generation prompt explicitly and repeatedly forbade this ('plain matte-black road cases... completely BLANK... no trade dress'). The take must be regenerated with genuinely blank/unbranded cases before this task can pass.

SOURCE-VIDEO ORIENTATION/COMPOSITION MISMATCH: the delivered take is portrait 1088x1920 with the performer CENTRED (empty stool on the LEFT, cases on the RIGHT), but the spec and asset_plan require a 1920x1080 LANDSCAPE take with the performer holding the LEFT THIRD. This inverts the engineered defect, breaks the 16:9-to-vertical reframe trap and emergent_checkpoint #1 (a centred portrait source cannot strand an empty stool in a vertical), and invalidates A1's source-dimension premise. Manifest also lists provider seedance-1.0, not the plan's declared veo-3, and duration 5.04s.

The two issues both trace to the one video file; the PDF being re-audited was fixed correctly (real 245KB PDF, embedded fonts + placed photo) and the sampled images (lampbox, act_03 screengrab, act_04 print sheet, act_01 in the PDF) are clean.
